name: orka
description: Bring shared Orka project context and teammate sessions into ChatGPT and Codex, and prepare handoffs for Claude Code.

interface.longDescription: Read the accepted knowledge and shared teammate sessions your Orka account can access. Find the right project, inspect source conversations, and prepare a Markdown handoff with a starter prompt for Claude Code. Version 0.1 is read-only and requires a compatible Orka service with its MCP integration enabled. Local private memory and automatic app launching are unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Bring me up to speed on one of my Orka projects.
Find a teammate’s shared sessions and explain their decisions.
Prepare this work for continuation in Claude Code.
